nina: Heads-up — new EU DSAR came in asking for full account + conversation delete + signed proof. Requester provided a company PO email (alice@bigcorp.com) which is NOT the account email on file. Any precedent for third-party rep verification? cc @compliance
adrian: Legal baseline: we require photo ID (govt) + at least one account-specific artifact (support ticket id, last 4 CC, or last login timestamp). For third-party reps: signed authorization on company letterhead OR a notarized attestation. Also confirm no legal hold. Keep the verification artifacts in the DSAR record.
ops-sam: Infra note: deletion surfaces = convo DB (Cassandra), embeddings cluster, S3 snapshots, offsite backups. Many backups are encrypted under key rotation history. Removing blobs is straightforward, but producing a content-level hash/proof requires decrypting archived blobs tied to old KEKs.
compliance: We checked registry: no active legal hold. There IS a retention_override ticket from Product (RO-889) tied to this customer for 90d retention last month. If that exists, Compliance must clear it before purge. Escalate to retention-team and attach the DSAR id.
sec-eng: Also flag: there's an open vuln triage for the snapshot ingestion path (PR#447). If we perform ad-hoc decrypts against old snapshots, we increase blast radius. Recommend either: 1) run decrypt/export in isolated VPC with no egress and ephemeral creds, or 2) wait until PR#447 is backported and deployed. We need a risk acceptance from Product if they want immediate action.
kms-bot: Tip: run `/dsar-prepare 5259001000` to get a draft proof bundle. Bundle includes: S3 object manifest, purge checklist, KMS key lineage (rotations), and CloudTrail/KMS audit pointers. Upload bundle to the DSAR ticket.
ops-sam: Proposed RBAC for operator: ephemeral role `dsar-processor` with TTL=30m. Minimal perms: `s3:GetObject`, `s3:ListBucket`, `kms:Decrypt` scoped to affected key IDs, plus `cassandra:read` for export. Tag the role/session with `dsar=5259001000` and `justification="DSAR export"`. Example assume-role command:
```bash
aws sts assume-role \\\--role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dsar-processor \\\--role-session-name dsar-5259001000 \\\--duration-seconds 1800
```
Make sure CloudTrail is configured to capture `kms:Decrypt` and STS AssumeRole events for the session.
nina: Can Ops scope kms:Decrypt to specific old key ARNs only? We don't want broad decrypt perms.
ops-sam: Yes — scope to explicit key ARNs used for those snapshots. We'll pull key lineage from the KMS rotation metadata before issuing role.
adrian: For the proof bundle: Compliance requires a signed deletion receipt containing: DSAR id, list of deleted object keys (or delete markers), KMS key IDs, operator principal, and CloudTrail links for the delete events. If we had to decrypt for proof, include a short justification and the ephemeral role audit trail.
compliance: After purge, store the proof bundle in Compliance Jira (attached) and mark the retention_override as revoked. Compliance will generate the signed receipt and send to requester.
sec-eng: One more: if decrypting archived backups, run plaintext extraction in a locked-down ephemeral workspace and shred any extracted plaintext immediately after hashing. Keep the hashes + audit, not the plaintext.
ops-sam: Agreed. Runbook draft I will produce: steps for verification -> mint ephemeral role -> run `/dsar-prepare` -> run export in isolated env -> apply vector db purge -> s3 delete + verify delete markers -> capture CloudTrail + KMS logs -> upload to Jira -> Compliance signs receipt.
adrian: Action items:
1) ops-sam: produce runbook + terraform snippet for `dsar-processor` + list of key ARNs (due EOD).
2) nina: collect requester verification artifacts and the PO/authorization letter (due today).
3) compliance: revoke retention_override RO-889 if present, or confirm no exception (ASAP).
4) sec-eng: advise on isolated env checklist for decrypt/export (hold until we sign off or patch).
5) legal: prepare template attestation for third-party reps.
nina: I'll start collecting docs now and will post them to the DSAR ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
